notes.title: Wishlist Zoetrope's New Game "Conarium" Today!
notes.notes:
We are much delighted to announce that Conarium Steam page is up and running, Rejoice!

Conarium is our latest attempt in developing another game with a chilling Lovecraftian story.

As Darkness Within games, we aimed to achieve the same spirit of Lovecraft's writings and Conarium won’t be an exception in this regard. We are heavily Inspired by the seminal novella “At the Mountains of Madness” by H.P. Lovecraft and some other weird macabre tales from the early twentieth century, Conarium tells a suspenseful tale of an antarctic expedition crew and  their endeavor to challenge what we normally consider to be the ‘absolute’ limits of nature. We have been focusing on the most essential elements for making any Lovecraftian experience even greater, story and atmosphere.

[url=store.steampowered.com/app/313780]Wishlist[/url] Conarium today!

notes.title: Soundtrack Available Now as DLC and Small Update
notes.notes:
For those who can’t enough of the haunting atmospheric in-game music, the original soundtrack containing well over an hour of music is now available for puchase at $ 2.99.

A small patch was also pushed this weekend:
-	Fixed a glitch causing ring cover puzzle to become impossible to solve.
-	Other small bug fixes.

notes.title: Director’s Cut Edition of Darkness Within 2 Launches on Steam Today !
notes.notes:
Having released a revamped version of Darkness Within: In Pursuit of Loath Nolder on Steam just three weeks ago, Iceberg Interactive and developer Zoetrope Interactive are now delighted to announce today’s Steam launch of the Director’s Cut Edition of the sequel, Darkness Within 2: The Dark Lineage. 

As one of the few games that have actually captured the H.P. Lovecraft vibe, the Darkness Within series creates an unsettling atmosphere, making the player feel uneasy throughout the game, without reverting to actual gore. This is perhaps best illustrated in the brand new trailer, when the main character refers to the voices only he can hear: “Hearing this, I know that every sane person would call me mad, and I truly hope I am...”

With the opportunity to present the game on the Steam platform, we created a much improved version, enhancing graphics, adding new locations and new puzzles; making the game a great experience for both new players as well as those familiar with the series. We really hope you’ll enjoy it as much as we did creating it.
